Enterprise Edition.note: Product edition name stays English. The existing catalog has 'Edição de Empresa' in a few 'about' strings; prefer the English name.

Team Edition.note: Stays English. The catalog has 'Edição de Equipa' once (about.teamEditiont0); prefer the English name.

Mattermost Cloud.note: Product name stays English; the bare edition label 'Cloud' was once rendered 'Nuvem' in about.cloudEdition.

Channels.note: As a product name keep English. The common noun 'channels' is 'canais'.

Playbooks.note: Product name stays English. One server string renders it 'Manuais'; do not reuse that.

Calls.note: Product name stays English; the common noun 'call' is 'chamada'.

System Console.note: Feminine: a Consola do Sistema. Not yet rendered in the existing catalog; keep this form consistently.

marketplace.note: The existing catalog keeps 'Marketplace' in English (5 occurrences, 'Marketplace de plugins'). Masculine: o Marketplace.

post.note: Same as message in user-facing strings. Admin/analytics strings use 'publicação' (e.g. 'Publicações de Robôs'); never 'artigo', which appears wrongly in a few channel-moderation strings.

thread.note: Masculine: o tópico, plural tópicos; the Threads view is 'Tópicos'. Not rendered in the existing catalog yet; a handful of keys ('muteConversation', 'leaveConversation') refer to the conversation, which is 'conversa'.

direct message.note: Feminine; plural 'mensagens diretas'. The abbreviation DM is not used in Portuguese UI; spell it out.

group message.note: Plural 'mensagens de grupo'. GM is spelled out.

mention.note: Verb: mencionar. Plural: menções. '@mention' stays '@menção' or keeps the literal @nome.

bookmark.note: Masculine: o marcador. Established in channel_bookmarks and permissions strings ('Gerir Marcadores'). Verb usage: 'adicionar marcador'.

saved messages.note: save = guardar, unsave = 'remover dos guardados' / 'deixar de guardar'. Established in channel_header.flagged.

do not disturb.note: Status label; DND is spelled out.

away.note: Established status label (userAccountMenu.awayMenuItem.label). Lowercase 'ausente' inside sentences.

online.note: Kept as 'Online' in the existing catalog (webapp and server).

offline.note: Kept as 'Offline' in the existing server catalog. 'desligado' is used only for a disconnected server.

guest.note: Masculine: o convidado, plural convidados. Guest access = 'Acesso de Convidado'. Note the same word is the past participle of 'convidar' (invited); rephrase if the sentence would be ambiguous.

system admin.note: Majority rendering (6 vs 2 'Administrador de Sistema' and one 'Administrador de Sistemas'); prefer 'do Sistema'.

channel admin.note: Catalog is split 2/2 with 'Administrador de Canal'; use 'do Canal' to parallel 'do Sistema' / 'da Equipa'.

sign in.note: Both 'sign in' and 'log in' = iniciar sessão (noun: início de sessão). The catalog addresses the user formally: 'Inicie sessão', never 'Entrar'/'Login'.

sign out.note: Both 'sign out' and 'log out' = terminar sessão (button: 'Terminar sessão').

join.note: 'juntar-se ao canal', 'juntou-se à equipa' (combined_system_message). Button label 'Juntar-se'. 'Aderir' appears in 'Qualquer Um Pode Aderir'.

archive.note: Adjective 'archived' = arquivado. Note 'arquivo' means archive, never 'file' (that is 'ficheiro').

mute.note: 'Silenciar canal'; unmute = 'Ativar som' / 'Deixar de silenciar'. Also used for microphone mute in Calls.

favorite.note: Masculine: o favorito; sidebar category 'Favoritos'. Verb: 'adicionar aos favoritos'; unfavorite: 'remover dos favoritos'.

search.note: Verb and button label 'Procurar' (5 vs 1 'Pesquisar'); noun 'procura'. 'browse' = explorar ('Explorar canais').

slash command.note: Established rendering (9 occurrences). Plural 'comandos da barra'.

webhook.note: Masculine: o webhook. Kept in English; the catalog wraps it in quotes in some strings ('webhook'), but plain 'webhook' is preferred.

trigger word.note: Plural 'palavras de ativação' (add_outgoing_webhook.triggerWords). A few strings have 'palavra de ativar'/'palavra de ação'; prefer 'palavra de ativação'.

plugin.note: Masculine: o plugin, plural plugins. Kept in English (150+ occurrences); never 'extensão'.

bot.note: Masculine: o bot. Majority keeps 'bot' (19 vs 2 'robô'). Bot account = 'conta de bot'.

role.note: Feminine; plural funções. Established in admin tables ('Função', 'Funções Permitidas'). Not 'papel'.

scheme.note: Masculine: o esquema. Permission scheme = 'esquema de permissões'.

trial.note: Majority rendering; free trial = 'versão de testes gratuita'. Noun form 'período de testes' when a period is meant. Not 'avaliação'.

workspace.note: Masculine: o espaço de trabalho (9 occurrences).

unread.note: Established in accessibility.sidebar.types.unread. 'Unreads' filter = 'Por ler'. Not 'não lido'.

channel purpose.note: Server catalog uses 'finalidade'; bare 'purpose' = finalidade. Not 'propósito'.

urgent.note: Priority label; lowercase 'urgente' in sentences. 'Important' = Importante.

recap.note: Masculine: o resumo, plural resumos. 'summary' is also 'resumo'; rely on context.

agent.note: Masculine: o agente, plural agentes. 'AI agent' = 'agente de IA'.

burn-on-read.note: Message type: 'mensagem de destruição após leitura'; label 'DESTRUIR APÓS LEITURA'. Not rendered in the existing catalog yet.

personal access token.note: Established: 'Código de Acesso Pessoal' (user.settings.tokens). 'token' is rendered 'código' throughout the webapp catalog.

announcement banner.note: Established in admin.customization.announcement strings; bare 'banner' = faixa. Note the server catalog keeps 'banner'; prefer 'faixa' in the webapp.

permalink.note: Kept in English in the existing catalog (8 occurrences). Masculine: o permalink.

nickname.note: Established in user.settings.general.nickname. Not 'alcunha'. Note 'apelido' also means surname in pt-PT; 'last name' is rendered 'apelido' too, so rely on context.

display name.note: Established in webapp and server ('nome a exibir'). Not 'nome de exibição'.

collapsed reply threads.note: Feature name; the Threads view itself is 'Tópicos'.

access control.note: Attribute-based access control = 'controlo de acesso baseado em atributos'; policy = 'política de controlo de acesso'. Never 'controle' (pt-BR).

attribute.note: Masculine: o atributo. Custom profile attribute = 'atributo de perfil personalizado'.

onboarding.note: The existing catalog leaves 'Onboarding' English twice; where a Portuguese noun is needed use 'integração inicial'. Prefer rephrasing ('primeiros passos', 'configuração inicial') when describing the first-run tour.

Town Square.note: Established default-channel name in server i18n (api.channel.create_default_channels.town_square).

Off-Topic.note: Established default-channel name in server i18n (api.channel.create_default_channels.off_topic).

read-only.note: Established: 'Canais de anúncio apenas de leitura'. Not 'somente leitura' (pt-BR).
